description: Sabotages only the documentation examples catch. Run with tools/run-sabotage.ps1; see tools/README-sabotage.md for the format. testArgs has no --lib because the harness cannot pre-build doctests: the suite runs whole, so it is kept to the entries only a doctest can see.

sabotages.name: SqEntry is no longer non_exhaustive
sabotages.why: TW-D-6: a further kind of entry must not break a caller. The only thing that fails when the attribute goes is a caller written outside the crate, which a documentation example is.

sabotages.name: control: the entry kinds are declared in another order
sabotages.why: The order of the variants is not a promise, and nothing matches on it.

sabotages.name: ReadEntry is no longer non_exhaustive
sabotages.why: A further kind of entry must not break a client. The only thing that fails when the attribute goes is a caller written outside the crate, which a documentation example is.
